Moving advice

A well-prepared departure.
A smoother arrival.

01

Before your quote

Walk through every room and list the main furniture. Note fragile items, pieces to dismantle and anything requiring storage. An approximate floor area helps if you do not know the volume.

02

Check access

Record floors, lift availability and dimensions, narrow stairs and parking options at both addresses. Mention restrictions before confirming your quote.

03

Prepare your boxes

Pack by room, label contents and mark fragile boxes. Keep weights manageable. Agree with CODEM which materials and preparation you will handle.

04

Specialist items

Mention pianos, artwork, mirrors and bulky furniture. Prepare dimensions and information about fragility. Handling needs assessment before moving day.

05

On moving day

Keep documents, medication, keys and essentials accessible. Review the agreed services and items needing special attention with the team.

06

Prepare for arrival

Plan furniture placement and room access. Clear box labels help with placement. Review the service with the team before they leave.

07

Insuring your belongings

Ask CODEM which cover applies during transport and its limits. List valuable items and their estimated value before the quote: they may need to be declared or specially protected.

08

Paperwork to plan ahead

Update your address, transfer or cancel energy, internet and home insurance contracts, and check with the town hall whether a parking permit is needed for the truck.

09

Moving abroad

Keep identity papers and important documents with you, prepare a detailed inventory and check the destination country’s formalities. CODEM confirms the documents needed for transport with you.
